name: Pea, Olive, and Preserved Lemon Salad

ingredients.name: finely chopped fresh cilantro leaves and tender stems
finely chopped preserved lemon flesh and rind
pitted red-brown olives, such as Kalamata, halved lengthwise

instructions.primary_message: In a large skillet, heat olive oil, ground turmeric, and ground ginger over medium-low heat for 5 minutes, swirling skillet occasionally, to allow spices to release their aromas.

Stir in green peas, cilantro, preserved lemon, garlic, and salt. Increase heat to medium, cover, and cook until green peas are bright green and fully warmed through, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove pan from heat, stir in olives, and season with additional salt if necessary. Serve warm or at room temperature.

schema_metadata.keywords: pea salad recipe, pea salad, pea salad recipes

description: In this easy anytime salad, sweet peas meet briny olives, preserved lemon, and the sharp, intense flavors of ground ginger and turmeric.
notes: Notes: I prefer using purple olives for this recipe but you can substitute with green ones.
author: Nargisse Benkabbou
